messages:
Nina K: quick flag on the weekly KPI snapshot 50. noticed an odd bump in webinar-driven MQLs for March cohort. can analytics sanity-check before we surface to execs? :wave:

Ravi S: on it. my quick look shows sessions up ~38% the day after the launch-post, but paid clicks and registrants didn't move. possible attribution bleed or sampling change.

Marta L: we changed the tracking pixel sampling for a short diag on 2024-03-12 (10% -> 60%) to debug missing impressions. iirc we reverted same day. could explain transient session inflation.

Owen B: confirmed the sample-rate bump and revert. pipelines used the raw sampled count for the streaming KPI widget, not normalized. i've kicked off a backfill to correct counts for 2024-03-10..2024-03-16. ETA ~90m.

Nina K: two asks: 1) analytics to add an "sample-normalized" line on the KPI board and annotate the pixel experiment; 2) growth to segment the webinar traffic by subject-line variant so we can attribute messaging lift separately.

Ravi S: will add the normalized time-series. SQL snippet i plan to use for adjustment:
```sql
SELECT day, SUM(unique_users) / NULLIF(mean_sample_rate,0) AS normalized_users
FROM daily_events
WHERE day BETWEEN '2024-03-09' AND '2024-03-20'
GROUP BY day;
```

Marta L: i've attached the send metadata and subject-line variants to the campaign doc. subject B had ~2.8x CTR vs A during the window.

dashbot: dashboard note: annotated sample-rate test on 2024-03-12 (id: a-20240312-sample). public KPI board updated with "normalized_sessions" series: https://dash.redwood.com/r/kpi-weekly

Nina K: perfect. once backfill completes can someone post a short summary and the revised snapshot to #marketing? i want to avoid a noisy exec alert about an artifact. thanks! :thumbsup:
